scope: Independent offline review of the additive recovery runner, unchanged official transport/pacer/liability ledger integration, and native handoff observer parser.

checks.finding: Release canonical hash, settings, source inventory, endpoint snapshots, schedules and initial requests are checked before credential loading; locked revalidation and exact terminal-history equality precede journal construction. Frozen local tokenizer and archived opaque-ID hashes are loaded and initial requests estimated before credential loading.

Actual first-cell request_body hash is checked before execute_decision and again against its returned provenance. Frozen preparation and execution both force submit_verdict with identical body encoding. Independent injected post-preflight drift produced zero reservations and zero HTTP entries.

Local recovery allocation is min($25 minus previous recovery exposure, remaining V3 $100 exposure, remaining lifetime $250 exposure) and min(600 minus previous recovery attempts, remaining V3 4000 attempts). Frozen unchanged ledger durably reserves worst-case 1,050,000 input and 64,000 output before each attempt and preserves the exact prior $0.6402 unknown liability.

One PacedOfficialTransport and one shared SlidingWindowPacer serve all workers, with max_workers=3, transport semaphore=3, and journal max_in_flight=3. Pacing precedes reservations, checks stops while waiting, and keeps credits through response plus 60 seconds. Independent overlap test observed no more than three mock HTTP entries.

Exactly six fresh capability cells precede all research. Research requires six valid correct verdicts and an unstopped journal. The fixed first wave contains 80 research cells from reference-1; all 480 assigned cells remain in reporting. Failed gate simulations produced zero research attempts.

Each decision performs one transport complete call; invalid tool output ends that sequential branch without a follow-up. Future exceptions immediately stop the journal; queued work checks stop and existing workers finish before terminal finalization. HTTP 429 and ambiguous timeouts retain conservative unknown liability with no automatic retry.

repair_started now requires a research response artifact containing body or http_status, which the unchanged transport writes only after HTTP returns. A reservation alone only increments research_requests_reserved. REPAIR_STARTED.json binds the confirmed reservation event and response path/hash. Independent pre-HTTP failure test produced no marker; actual mock HTTP 429 produced a marker with zero accepted research responses.

Recovery decisions expose only submit_verdict and never execute generated tools or code. Actor histories and packet contents are copied; ordered provider items are retained unchanged, opaque reasoning is not decoded, and valid submissions receive only the original syntactic acknowledgment. Evaluator truth/evidence scores are not inserted into subsequent histories.

Native lock parsing preserves every positive numeric PID and accepts only numeric descriptor records after a PID. Unknown/orphan fields fail closed. Inherited readiness still requires the exact stopped owner, sole lock ownership, no subprocess or sandbox activity, zero local open/unresolved reservations, and unchanged durable evidence; finalizer requires verified death and exclusive lock ownership.

resolved_findings.resolution: Root replaced reservation-only repair_started with HTTP-response evidence, preserving reservation count separately; independently regression-tested.
Root added the actual first-request hash check before execute_decision; independently injected drift resulted in zero physical attempts.

limitations: Offline security clearance is specific to this release hash and reviewed source bytes; it does not replace science/accounting review or grant new spending authorization.

repair_started is conservative response-confirmed evidence. A request that times out without an HTTP response artifact can have been dispatched while repair_started remains false; its reservation and unresolved liability remain recorded.
Pacing is an empirical scheduling estimate, not a provider token guarantee; any rate-limit rejection still stops without retry.
The first wave contains one source dyad. Completion of 80 research cells leaves 400 assigned research cells unknown and does not complete the six-source study.
